metadata.title: Appwrite Project Structure and Database Schema

story.iWant: Appwrite databases, tables, and initial schema configured
story.soThat: the backend is ready to store village data with proper relationships
story.tasks: - Task 1: Create Appwrite Project (COMPLETE) - Task 2: Create Database and Core Tables (COMPLETE) - Task 3: Configure Relationships and Indexes - Task 4: Configure Permissions - Task 5: Document Database Schema

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Appwrite project created with appropriate name and configuration
Core tables created with schemas: users, residents, households, roles
Indexes created for common queries (household_id, role_ids)
Appwrite permissions configured for table-level access control
Documentation added to README for database schema

doc.title: Architecture Document - Section 2.2 Backend Services
doc.snippet: Appwrite Databases service provides NoSQL database for all village data. Tables are equivalent to tables in relational databases with columns defining schema fields (string, integer, datetime, etc.). Relationships configured through Appwrite console or SDK. Permissions support table-level and row-level access control.

doc.title: Architecture Document - Section 3.1 Architectural Decisions
doc.snippet: Normalized schema pattern: Separate tables for each entity, ID-based relationships (store foreign key IDs like household_id in residents), no data duplication. Indexing strategy: Create indexes on all foreign key fields and frequently queried fields.

doc.title: Product Requirements Document - FR-1
doc.snippet: Comprehensive profile information (name, DOB, gender, contact details). Support multi-role assignment where users can hold multiple roles simultaneously. Track resident relationships to households with defined roles. Manage storage quotas per user based on primary role.

doc.title: Product Requirements Document - FR-2
doc.snippet: Add, edit, and delete households with name, head resident, address. Link multiple residents to each household. Track household composition and relationships.

doc.title: Product Requirements Document - FR-3
doc.snippet: RBAC with permissions union when users hold multiple roles. Storage quotas per role (Admin: unlimited, Village Head: 20GB, Teachers: 5GB, Residents: 2GB, Learners: 1GB).

doc.title: Appwrite Setup Guide
doc.snippet: Step-by-step guide for creating 4 tables (users, residents, households, roles) with 22 columns, 4 indexes, and permissions configuration. Includes automated setup script and manual console instructions.

artifact.reason: Existing Appwrite SDK integration with TablesDB service initialized. Story must use this boot file for all database operations.
Existing test page for verifying Appwrite connection and TablesDB access. Can be used to verify database setup completion.

constraints.constraint: All components must use Vue 3 script setup syntax - NEVER use export default
Database schema must be normalized: ID-based relationships, no data duplication
Use tables service from src/boot/appwrite.js for all database operations
Follow naming conventions: PascalCase for components, camelCase for composables/utils/stores
Tasks 3-5 require manual Appwrite console configuration - cannot be fully automated
All paths in documentation must be project-relative (e.g., docs/architecture.md not absolute paths)

tests.standards: Manual testing required for this story. Verify database and tables created in Appwrite console. Test CRUD operations on each table using Appwrite SDK (TablesDB). Verify relationships work correctly (query residents by household_id). Test indexes improve query performance. Verify permissions prevent unauthorized access. Use AppwriteTestPage.vue at /appwrite-test for verification.
